<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse detection module. Detects transitions from 0 to 1 to 0 and outputs a pulse signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIAL">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_START">State after detecting a rising edge.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_END">State after detecting a falling edge.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" type="enum" enum_id="state">Current state of the pulse detection process.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" type="enum" enum_id="state">Next state of the pulse detection process.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            case(state)
                INITIAL: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = PULSE_START;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                PULSE_START: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = PULSE_END;
                    else
                        next_state = PULSE_START;
                end
                PULSE_END: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = PULSE_START;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                default: next_state = INITIAL;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= INITIAL;
                data_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
                if(next_state == PULSE_END && data_in == 1'b0)
                    data_out <= 1'b1;
                else
                    data_out <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Sequential logic for pulse detection.</implementation>
</module>
